explanation: Refused: the requested eta point is physically impossible because W = 1.4500 GeV is below the e p -> e' p eta production threshold of 1.4861 GeV. It is also outside the eta lookup-table grid [1.4856, 6.0000] GeV, so EXCLURAD would extrapolate the hadronic model. A validated eta grid starts at W >= 1.4961 GeV.
